task_completion.description: The agent opens a DICOM viewer or medical imaging software and loads a scan from the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A medical imaging application (e.g., Horos, Weasis, or a custom viewer) is visible on the screen with a CT or XA scan loaded.

task_completion.description: The agent places a Region of Interest (ROI) tool over a high-density bone structure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A circular, rectangular, or freehand ROI is visible over a bright (high-density) area of the image, labeled or identified as 'Bone'.

task_completion.description: The agent places a Region of Interest (ROI) tool in the background/air area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A second ROI is visible in the dark background area of the scan, labeled or identified as 'Air'.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies the Mean HU/pixel values for both the Bone and Air ROIs from the software interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The software's ROI statistics overlay or a side panel shows 'Mean' values for both selected regions.

task_completion.description: The agent saves a screenshot of the interface showing both ROIs to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal output confirms the creation of '~/DICOM/exports/qa_rois.png'.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a text file containing the Bone Mean, Air Mean, and the calculated SBR ratio.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command shows the content of '~/DICOM/exports/bone_air_ratio.txt' with the required numerical values.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface to measure ROIs rather than just using command-line tools to manipulate files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with ROI tools and the imaging software's UI elements.

integrity.description: The values in the text file match the values displayed in the software's ROI statistics.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Mean values visible in the software screenshot match the numbers written in the final .txt report.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the privileged information values without performing the measurement.
integrity.visual_evidence: The ROIs are physically drawn on the image in the screenshot, and the values are derived from the specific placement of those ROIs.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task may use either a synthetic CT (where Bone Mean is ~976 and Air Mean is ~-1024) or an XA scan (0002.DCM) where Bone Mean is ~200 and Air/Background Mean is 0. If the background/Air mean is 0, the agent may encounter a division by zero error; look for how they handle the ratio calculation. The Bone Mean must be between 100 and 3000. The output must be saved to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/bone_air_ratio.txt and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/qa_rois.png.
